name: AI Chat Input

placeholders.description: Placeholder strings the field cycles through while empty and unfocused.

maxRows.description: Maximum visible rows before the field scrolls instead of growing further.

spring.description: Spring used for the height grow, ready scale-in and submit press animations.

suggestions.description: Suggestion chips that fill the field with their text when clicked.

submitOnEnter.description: Enter submits; Shift+Enter always inserts a newline instead.

busy.description: Initial busy state; the send button becomes a pulsing stop button.

maxLength.description: Maximum character length, or no limit.

a11y: The field requires a real `<label>` from the host, visible or visually hidden; the placeholder is never the field's only label.
The send button has `aria-label="Send"`, which switches to `"Stop"` together with `aria-busy="true"` while busy.
Suggestion chips are real `<button>`s, reachable and activatable by keyboard.
A visually-hidden `aria-live="polite"` status region announces "Sending…" while busy.
Focus rings are visible on the field, send button and chips; the default theme keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast.
Enter submits and Shift+Enter inserts a newline; IME composition (`isComposing`) is respected so composing text never submits early.
